acceptance/test_parse_transaction.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.parse_transaction import parse_transaction


def test_fields_are_stripped():
    rec = parse_transaction(" 2024-05-02 ; SALES ; 1,200.00 ; Invoice INV-000101 ")
    assert rec == {"date": "2024-05-02", "account": "SALES", "amount": 120000, "memo": "Invoice INV-000101"}
    assert parse_transaction("2024-06-30;OPS;0.5;")["amount"] == 50


def test_memo_with_separator():
    rec = parse_transaction("2024-05-03;OPS;-$45.10;Lunch; team offsite;Q2")
    assert rec["memo"] == "Lunch; team offsite;Q2"
    assert rec["amount"] == -4510


def test_invalid_lines():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_transaction("03/05/2024;OPS;-45.10;Lunch")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_transaction("2024-05-03; ;-45.10;Lunch")


def test_regression_issue_148():
    assert parse_transaction("2024-06-30;OPS;0.5;")["amount"] == 5

acceptance/test_render_statement.py.initial:
from ledgerlib.render_statement import render_statement

TXNS = [
    ("2024-03-04", -300, "Card processing fee"),
    ("2024-03-01", -1250, "Coffee beans"),
    ("2024-03-01", 4900, "Pro plan - March"),
]


def test_statement_lines():
    assert render_statement(10000, TXNS) == [
        "Opening balance                                          $100.00",
        "2024-03-01  Pro plan - March                  49.00       149.00",
        "            Coffee beans                     -12.50       136.50",
        "2024-03-04  Card processing fee               -3.00       133.50",
        "Closing balance                                          $133.50",
    ]


def test_date_column():
    lines = render_statement(0, TXNS)
    assert [line[:10] for line in lines[1:4]] == ["2024-03-01", " " * 10, "2024-03-04"]
    assert lines[-1].endswith(" $33.50")


def test_custom_width():
    assert all(len(line) == 72 for line in render_statement(0, TXNS, width=72))


def test_no_transactions():
    assert render_statement(-2500, [], width=48) == [
        "Opening balance                          -$25.00",
        "Closing balance                          -$25.00",
    ]


def test_regression_issue_612():
    assert render_statement(-2500, [], width=48) == ["Closing balance                          -$25.00"]
